scope: Acceptance test of the FROZEN Stage 1-6 Temporal Intelligence implementation. No production code, frontend, API, or configuration modified.

test_suite_results.known_unrelated_failure: test_backend.py::test_weather_union_telemetry_ingestion (live Open-Meteo network dependency) -- confirmed still the only failure, not modified

acceptance_table.evidence: normal_results.json: median=0.354, P95=0.919, P99=1.0, 9.65% >0.70, 21.2% reason-rate, 85.7% LSTM availability -- identical to Stage 5/6's documented figures. New finding: the longest continuous elevated run (864 steps) traces to exactly 2/75 stations, the same boundary-humidity stations flagged in Stage 1.5 as a data-generation artifact, not a code defect.
acceptance_table.notes: Known, previously documented limitation. Not a new correctness failure.

acceptance_table.evidence: anomaly_results.json: 8/10 types detected (score>0.70) with correct rule/LSTM contribution; missing_observation and stale_packet correctly do NOT force a residual-based detection, matching designed behavior from Stage 3/4.
acceptance_table.notes: No anomaly type regressed relative to Stage 3/5/6 findings.

acceptance_table.evidence: anomaly_results.json per-type normal_period_prediction_sample vs event_period_prediction_sample: predicted temperature tracks actual closely in normal periods (residual near zero) and residual visibly widens during injected events (e.g. temperature_spike, temperature_drift).
acceptance_table.notes: Synthetic-data engineering validation only; no real-world accuracy claim.

acceptance_table.evidence: Classification per type in anomaly_results.json: spike/drop/pressure_offset/humidity_offset = both_contribute; frozen_temperature/frozen_humidity/temperature_drift = rule_dominated; noise_burst = lstm_dominated; missing/stale = insufficient_evidence. Matches Stage 3/5's established characterization -- rules remain authoritative for persistent faults, LSTM adds value for sudden/drift deviations.
acceptance_table.notes: Consistent with frozen system design; no drift from prior stages.

acceptance_table.evidence: recovery_results.json: all detected anomaly types recover (score<0.5 sustained) within 60-380 minutes of event end, scaling sensibly with each event's own duration (e.g. pressure_offset's 400-min-long injected offset recovers in 380min; single-step spike/drop recover in 70min). No indefinite persistence observed.

robustness_results.json stage6_bug_regression: all 3 Stage 6 bugs directly re-confirmed fixed (rollback resets history_complete len 144->1; no false temp_spike from rollback; gap-triggering reading correctly reports lstm_available=False instead of using stale history; duplicate and out-of-order readings also correctly reset). Gap-boundary behavior exact: just-below/at threshold=no reset, just-above=reset.
acceptance_table.notes: All 3 fixes remain intact; also passed via the full test_stage6_* suites (19/19).

acceptance_table.evidence: Reuses Stage 6's 5-day/5-station long-run result (stage6_results/stage6_long_run.json): 0.0% false-positive rate outside every injected event window, clean recovery in 50-80 minutes for every event. Not re-run here (frozen system, no code changed since Stage 6) -- re-verified applicable since evaluate() output is byte-identical on unchanged input.

robustness_results.json output_contract: evaluate() returns exactly (score, channel_scores, reason, detail); no NaN/Inf found; all scores in [0,1]; lstm detail present exactly when available; LSTM correctly skipped during warm-up.
acceptance_table.notes: API unchanged, confirmed by direct inspection.

acceptance_table.evidence: robustness_results.json performance: 2.063 ms/reading average vs Stage 5/6 baseline of ~2.0ms (3.1% difference, within measurement noise). No meaningful regression.

final_decision: Temporal Intelligence is ACCEPTED and FROZEN for Stage 7.
reasoning: No new concrete correctness failure was found. All previously documented limitations (9.6% of normal readings >0.70, 21.2% reason-string rate, synthetic-data-only validation) are reproduced exactly and remain accepted, documented limitations rather than blocking defects. The one new observation (2/75 stations with persistently elevated scores) was traced conclusively to an already-documented Stage 1.5 data-generation artifact, not a Temporal Intelligence code defect, and does not warrant a correction.
